shots.visual: A middle-aged strategist bowing low, pressing head firmly against cold marble palace floor, eyes glinting with ambition in dim torchlight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 臣司馬懿，願效犬馬之勞！

shots.visual: A mature emperor sitting on imperial throne, smiling subtly with a calm yet intimidating gaze.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 愛卿快快請起。

shots.visual: Extreme close-up on emperor's eyes, showing profound calculation behind a warm smile.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 洛陽，終於回歸大漢了。

shots.visual: Grand palace interior decorated with red pillars, armor scattered on ground, heavily guarded by victorious soldiers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 洛陽大局已定，曹丕餘黨盡誅。

shots.visual: Hands offering a golden imperial jade seal wrapped in silk, stained with dried blood.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 逆賊曹丕已死，獻上魏國印璽。

shots.visual: A advisor holding feather fan standing on left, staring skeptically at kneeling strategist on right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 司馬大人果真是雷霆手段。

shots.visual: Strategist looking up slightly with humble smile, cupping hands politely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 丞相過獎，臣不過是順應天命。

shots.visual: Face rising slowly, sharp glint flashing across eyes, dark shadow covering half of face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 大漢天威，誰敢不服？

shots.visual: Emperor walking slowly down steps, robes trailing gracefully on stone floor.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 好一個順應天命！

shots.visual: Emperor standing over kneeling strategist, shadow casting completely over him.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 從今以後，你便是漢朝重臣。

shots.visual: Strategist lowering head again, subtle smirking corner of mouth hidden in darkness.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 微臣定當肝腦塗地，死而後已。

shots.visual: Emperor placing hand firmly on strategist's shoulder, grip tightening visibly.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 希望你記住今天說的話。

shots.visual: Advisor raising feather fan slightly, observing emperor's hand movement intently.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公心中早有定數。

shots.visual: Strategist rising slowly, holding hands together in respectful gesture before stepping back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 臣先退下籌備兵馬，迎接主公。

shots.visual: Strategist walking towards giant grand doors, long shadow stretching across blood-stained floor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 狼顧之相已現，洛陽暗潮湧動。

shots.visual: Advisor stepping closer to emperor on right, face full of concern and urgency.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，此人萬萬不可輕信。

shots.visual: Emperor staring at palace entrance, cold scorn visible on face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 朕何嘗不知，他是一條毒蛇。

shots.visual: Emperor turning slightly towards advisor on right, cold smile playing on lips.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 朕就是要用這條蛇，咬死孫權。

shots.visual: Advisor shaking head slightly, worry deepened on forehead, feather fan stopped in mid-air.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 但養虎為患，恐遭反噬！

shots.visual: Emperor's hand gripping sword hilt firmly, veins popping on knuckles.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 在他牙拔掉前，他只能聽話。

shots.visual: Advisor's face frozen in fear, eyes looking into distance as light fades around him.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，他眼底血光比曹丕更重。
